Chasing costs 17.5 runs in the The Hundred — but that hides a wide spread

Across 73 matches at these grounds a first innings averages 154.0 and a chase 136.5, at 7.27 runs an over. On first-innings scoring that places the The Hundred 5th among the 10 T20 leagues we hold ground data for, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.

The league average is the least interesting number on this page. Chasing costs 23.8 runs at Old Trafford, Manchester and only 2.0 at Sophia Gardens, Cardiff. The highest-scoring ground on the list is Edgbaston, Birmingham at 7.7 an over. A total that wins comfortably at one of these grounds loses at another.

These are T20 records for each ground rather than for this competition alone, so treat them as ground character. Sample sizes vary a lot — a ground with five matches behind it deserves far less weight than one with a hundred, and both are in the table rather than hidden behind an average. The live model does not use these figures: once a ball is bowled it reads the actual over-by-over run and wicket pattern instead.

How the live prediction works

It starts when the match does. There is no pre-match tip here. Win probability is recalculated after every ball from the score, wickets in hand, balls and runs remaining, and how the pitch is behaving in this innings rather than on average.

Measured, not claimed. 81.5% win-probability accuracy on a true holdout: trained on 2017-2024 matches only, then scored on 2,546 matches from 2025-26 the model had never seen. Accuracy rises through an innings, from 79.2% at over 6 to 82.2% by over 15.

Next-over forecasts too. Expected runs for the coming over land inside the published range 72.3% of the time, measured across 46,718 over-boundary snapshots.

The Hundred predictions — FAQs

Which The Hundred ground is hardest to chase at?
Old Trafford, Manchester. Across 11 matches there, sides batting first average 151.0 and sides chasing 127.2 — a 23.8-run gap. The most forgiving is Sophia Gardens, Cardiff, where the same gap is 2.0.
What is a good score in the The Hundred?
Across 73 matches at the grounds listed, a first innings averages 154.0 and a chase 136.5, at 7.27 runs an over. That puts the The Hundred 5th of the 10 T20 leagues we track for first-innings scoring, against PSL at 172.4 and BPL at 139.2.
Who will win tonight's The Hundred match?
We do not publish pre-match tips. Ball-by-ball records for the grounds this competition uses, 73 matches in total. They are T20 records for each ground rather than records for this competition alone, so read them as ground character.
